name: North Industries Group Red Arrow Co., Ltd
summary: North Industries Group Red Arrow Co., Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sale of special equipment, superhard materials, special-purpose vehicles, and automotive parts in China, Europe, the Americas, Southeast Asia, and internationally. It offers special equipment for armed forces and other military enterprises; and superhard materials, including lab-grown diamond finished products, lab-grown diamonds, industrial diamond, synthetic diamond, high-performance superhard material composite sheet, and cubic boron nitride.
